name: @pipeworx/mcp-seo-keywords-ads

tools.name: seo_keyword_google_ads_volume
tools.description: Exact Google Ads search volume for `<keyword>` — Google's own monthly search-volume numbers (plus competition and CPC) from the Ads API, for up to 10 keywords. Use when you specifically need Google Ads figures; for general SEO volume + keyword difficulty, prefer seo_keyword_overview (cheaper). Example: seo_keyword_google_ads_volume({ keywords: ["running shoes"], location_code: 2840, _apiKey: "your-base64-key" })

keywords.description: Keywords to look up (max 10), e.g. ["running shoes", "trail shoes"]

_apiKey.description: DataForSEO API key = base64("login:password") from your dataforseo.com account

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-seo-keywords-ads forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the seo-keywords-ads pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
